description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the distribution of tweets across different quantities of labels. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Number of labels," and displays discrete numerical values ordered sequentially from 0 to 5. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Number of tweets," using a linear scale with a range starting from 0 and extending beyond 400,000. The numeric tick labels on the vertical axis are regularly spaced at intervals of 100,000, showing 0, 200000, 300000, and 400000, with a grey rectangular artifact obscuring the 100000 mark. There are six individual bars corresponding to each category on the horizontal axis. The bar for category 0 is blue and indicates a value near zero. The tallest bar corresponds to category 1, colored light brown, with an approximate value of 480,000. The bar for category 2 is green and represents approximately 410,000 tweets. Category 3 is represented by a dark red bar with a value of roughly 90,000. The bars for categories 4 (purple) and 5 (barely visible) are the shortest, both representing values very close to zero. The bars are ordered sequentially by their category labels from 0 to 5 rather than by height, and no specific bars are visually emphasized.
